svg.title: Four sequences of 100, 300, 900 and 200 tokens laid out with padding (58% waste), naive packing (58% of causal attention cells cross examples) and boundary-aware packing (position_ids restart, no cross-example attention); throughput about 2x on FLAN and 1.4x on OrcaMath with identical validation loss.

g.text: Lengths 100, 300, 900, 200 (1,500 tokens). Padding waste 1 − 1500/(4·900) = 58%. Cross-example share 1 − Σnᵢ(nᵢ+1)/(n(n+1)) = 58%.
